name: UniMate (preview)
description: UniMate (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026): one model that animates diverse skeletons from text. Driven here on a Mixamo humanoid skeleton.

code.install: Set up the isolated motion worker in the ComfyUI_VNCCS_Utils folder: 'motion_worker/install.sh unimate' then 'motion_worker/run.sh unimate' (Windows: install.bat / run.bat; Docker: docker compose -f motion_worker/docker-compose.yml --profile unimate up -d --build). See motion_worker/README.md. Clone the model code too: 'git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Friedrich-M/UniMate models/text_to_motion/code/UniMate'.

requirements.notes: Preview checkpoints. Text-only and limited to one 60-frame (2 s) window at 30 fps; Pose Studio applies the movement on top of the current pose. Only joint positions are generated, so hands, feet and head keep their start orientation. Set options.object_type to choose which Mixamo skeleton is used (default: the first one in the features).

guide.summary: Research preview (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026). Short clips of at most 2 s, joint positions only; cannot start from your pose.
guide.best_for: Trying the newest research model on short actions
guide.setup_effort: Expert: isolated worker, a code checkout and skeleton features built with UniMate's data pipeline

setup.label: Isolated motion worker
setup.detail: The model runs in its own venv next to this extension, so ComfyUI's packages are never changed and your other workflows keep running. In the custom_nodes/ComfyUI_VNCCS_Utils folder run the command once (it creates the venv), then keep the worker running next to ComfyUI. Windows (also ComfyUI portable): motion_worker\install.bat unimate, then motion_worker\run.bat unimate. No Python on the machine? Install uv first; the script then downloads Python 3.11 into the venv by itself. Optional, if you already use Docker: docker compose -f motion_worker/docker-compose.yml --profile unimate up -d --build

setup.label: UniMate code
setup.detail: Clone the repository into ComfyUI's models folder. Run the command from the ComfyUI folder. The worker installs what it needs; do not install the repository's requirements.txt into ComfyUI.

setup.label: Checkpoint (Linzhan/UniMate)
setup.detail: Downloads config.json, dataset_stats.npy and the newest checkpoint from Hugging Face into models/text_to_motion/UniMate.

setup.label: Mixamo skeleton features
setup.detail: UniMate takes its skeleton from preprocessed features. Build dataset/features/mixamo with UniMate's data_process pipeline and copy that folder to models/text_to_motion/UniMate/features/mixamo.
